title: Identifying protocol versions
summary: Game revision, Login revision and the client technical context.
description:
# Protocol identification

## Independent properties

| Property | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Game revision | Revision used in the initial game exchange |
| Login revision | Login protocol revision |
| Branch and release | Historical game context |
| Build | A specific client artifact |

## Reused numbers

Revision **152** appears in different generations. The reference therefore distinguishes `152`, `152-rev-1` and `152-rev-2`. The suffix belongs to this reference; the actual value remains 152 in every case.

Matching numbers do not establish field, opcode or client-behaviour compatibility. Each source supports only the facts it actually establishes.
